task.title: Modifying your Google Cloud Platform object bucket
task.shortdesc: To enable virtual builds with Google Cloud Platform storage in Red Hat Quay, you can configure cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) settings in your GCP bucket. This allows build workers to upload Dockerfiles and access build artifacts.

note.p: Currently, modifying your Google Cloud Platform object bucket is not supported on IBM Power and IBM Z.
